about: Same five-step ladder as reviews.json (see its 'about'). {X} = the name he picks or types; {a}/{plural} = the kind of thing. 'against' marks the other side (the empty square on the card). · 7 Nov 2026: each slot has a 'label' (what the student sees: First reason, Second reason …) and a q that names the job exactly — 'adds a reason' was true of the other side too. · 22 Nov 2026: the first option in each slot is the essay's core set (the Guided essays and card 1): Few people would deny that / Firstly, it is often argued that the main advantage of / Secondly, it is widely believed that another point in favour of / On the other hand, it must be acknowledged that one serious drawback of / On balance, I believe that. · 25 Nov 2026 (the owner, after the content check): every way is a phrase the task's own model texts use (the Model and Guided/Sample steps), three alternatives per move, the moves in the models' order, so Basics teaches what the practice shows. · 'example' on a subject: the five sentences finished for its first answer (eg), each starting with its move's first way; Basics shows them on its card (25 Nov 2026, the owner: immediately likeable).
name: Essay
how: An essay in five sentences, as the Guided essays build it: introduce the topic, your first point, your second point, your own idea, and your conclusion.

nameAsk.title: Which one?
nameAsk.aim: Pick a topic you have an opinion on. You’ll write about it.

notebook: Write your essay on {X} in five sentences, one per slot. Then check:
ticks: My first sentence introduces the topic.
Each reason has an example of my own.
My conclusion says clearly what I think.

subjects.label: Technology
example: Few people would deny that smartphones have changed the way teenagers live.
Firstly, there is no doubt that they help us to keep in touch with friends and family.
Secondly, it is often argued that they make it easier to find information for school.
Finally, it seems to me that they can also stop us from sleeping well.
All things considered, I firmly believe that smartphones do more good than harm.

subjects.label: School
example: Few people would deny that homework is part of every student's life.
Firstly, there is no doubt that it helps us to remember what we learn in class.
Secondly, it is often argued that it teaches us to organise our time.
Finally, it seems to me that too much homework leaves no time for sport or friends.
All things considered, I firmly believe that a little homework is useful, but not every night.

subjects.label: The environment
example: Few people would deny that cheap flights have made travelling much easier.
Firstly, there is no doubt that more families can now afford a holiday abroad.
Secondly, it is often argued that they help tourism on islands like Madeira.
Finally, it seems to me that planes cause a lot of pollution.
All things considered, I firmly believe that we should fly less and choose trains when we can.

subjects.label: Free time
example: Few people would deny that team sports are popular with young people.
Firstly, there is no doubt that they keep us fit and healthy.
Secondly, it is often argued that they teach us to work with others.
Finally, it seems to me that they are a great way to make new friends.
All things considered, I firmly believe that every teenager should try a team sport.

subjects.label: City life
example: Few people would deny that living in a big city has many advantages.
Firstly, there is no doubt that there are more things to do, like concerts and museums.
Secondly, it is often argued that it is easier to find a good job.
Finally, it seems to me that big cities can be noisy and expensive.
All things considered, I firmly believe that a smaller town is a better place to grow up.

slots.q: Which one makes your first point?

ways.t: Firstly, there is no doubt that …
Firstly, it is often argued that …
Firstly, it is widely believed that …

slots.label: First point

slots.job: make your second point, or show the other side
slots.q: Which one makes your second point?

ways.t: Secondly, it is often argued that …
Secondly, it is widely believed that …
On the other hand, it must be acknowledged that …

slots.label: Second point

slots.q: Which one adds your own idea?

ways.t: Finally, it seems to me that …
Finally, it seems to me that another key point is that …

slots.label: Your own idea

ways.t: All things considered, I firmly believe that …
